SELECT COALESCE(SUM( p.gross_salary - (coalesce(pd.tax,0)+ coalesce(pd.insurance,0)+ coalesce(pd.leave_deduction,0)+ coalesce(pd.late_deduction,0)+ coalesce(pd.other_deduction,0))
), 0) AS totalNetSalary FROM employee e join payroll p on p.employee_id = e.id LEFT JOIN payroll_deduction pd ON p.id = pd.payroll_id;

SELECT d.name AS name, COALESCE(SUM( p.gross_salary - (coalesce(pd.tax,0)+ coalesce(pd.insurance,0)+ coalesce(pd.leave_deduction,0)+ coalesce(pd.late_deduction,0)+ coalesce(pd.other_deduction,0))
), 0) AS netSalary FROM department d LEFT JOIN employee e ON e.department_id = d.id LEFT JOIN payroll p ON p.employee_id = e.id LEFT JOIN payroll_deduction pd ON p.id = pd.payroll_id GROUP BY d.name;
